description: Every first-order sentence consequence \(\varphi\models\psi\) has an interpolant obtained by including an actual sentence of the sublanguage on the exact intersection of their finite symbol supports; the ambient language may be arbitrary.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.sentence_interpolation.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (φ ψ : L.Sentence) (h : {φ} ⊨ᵇ ψ) :
  ∃ η,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.SentenceInterpolant φ ψ
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols φ ∩
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols ψ)).onSentence
        η)
